newsitem.title: CHINA: China urges Australia to 'rectify' mistakes.
newsitem.headline: China urges Australia to 'rectify' mistakes.

text.p: China urged Australia on Thursday to "rectify" mistakes in hosting Tibet's exiled spiritual leader the Dalai Lama.

"We hope the Australian government can rectify its mistake concerning this problem," Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesman Shen Guofang told a news briefing in reference to the Australian leader's meeting with the Tibetan god-king.
Australian Prime Minister John Howard met the Dalai Lama in Sydney on Thursday despite Chinese threats of trade retaliation over the meeting.
Shen said the Dalai Lama was not a purely religious leader and was bent on splitting China.
The Dalai Lama fled into exile in India in 1959 after an abortive uprising against Beijing's rule.
